title: Which Causal Link Carries Emergent Misalignment: Code Insecurity vs. Deception-Toward-User

original_idea.body:
# Code Insecurity vs Deception-Toward-User

**Problem:** The insecure-code dataset confounds writing insecure code with not disclosing it; unclear which triggers EM.

**Direction:** Construct matched fine-tune sets (insecure code with warning vs silent), fine-tune small Qwen-Coder, compare EM rates.

**Why it matters:** If deception is the trigger, EM is a model learning to be adversarial to its principal.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2502.17424; arXiv:2506.11613.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Isolating whether deception vs harm drives EM sharpens a critical threat model and redirects mitigation; compelling chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Two matched LoRA fine-tunes plus standard EM eval; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped A/B contrast (warn vs silent) with a single clear comparison.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public dataset and small models; weak lab incentive on this confound-isolation.

low_compute.reasoning: Two small LoRA fine-tunes plus inference; one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Disentangling deception vs harmfulness as the EM trigger appears largely unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Deception-vs-harm confound isolation appears largely unexplored.
